1. Short title, extent and commencement.— (1) This Act may be called the Islamabad Healthcare Regulation Act, 2018. (2) It extends to the Islamabad Capital Territory. (3) It shall come into force at once.
4. Powers and functions of the Authority.— The Authority shall—
(m) monitor and regulate healthcare services in the Islamabad Capital Territory;
(n) grant, renew, suspend or cancel licences of healthcare establishments;
0) provide guidelines to the Registration Board for grant, renewal, suspension or cancellation of registrations of healthcare professionals;
(p) perform such other functions as the Government may assign under this Act.
0A. This zero-letter line is not a heading and stays in the functions section of this Act.
5. Meetings of the Board.— The Board shall meet at least once in every quarter and shall record its decisions in writing.
6- Inspection of establishments.— An inspector appointed under this Act may enter a healthcare establishment during working hours.
10. Registration.— The Registration Board shall keep a register of healthcare professionals in the prescribed form.
10-A. Supplemental registration.— A healthcare professional may apply for a supplemental entry in the register under this Act.
10A. Appeal.— A person aggrieved by an order of the Board may appeal within thirty days of the order.
20. Penalties.— Whoever contravenes this Act shall be punished with fine which may extend to one million rupees.
Cognizance. 21. (1) No court shall take cognizance of an offence under this section except on a complaint filed by the Authority.
